Overview of ShadowBroker

ShadowBroker is an open-source decentralized intelligence project designed to aggregate multi-domain open-source intelligence (OSINT) telemetry into a single interactive map interface. The platform combines dozens of public datasets, including aircraft tracking, maritime traffic, satellite orbits, seismic activity, and geopolitical news feeds, into a cohesive operational view.

Core Architecture and Features

Built using Next.js, MapLibre GL, FastAPI, and Python, the software operates via self-hosted deployments without built-in analytics or tracking accounts. Key capabilities include:

  • Multi-Domain Tracking: Visualizes commercial and military flights, marine vessels via AIS, orbital satellites, and land transit.
  • Reconnaissance Toolkit: Provides server-side tools for IP geolocation, DNS lookups, WHOIS data, and certificate transparency checks with Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) protections.
  • Agent Integration: Features an HMAC-signed command channel allowing external AI agents, such as OpenClaw implementations, to query telemetry and interact with map data.
  • Experimental Testnet (InfoNet): Includes an experimental communication mesh utilizing Tor and Reticulum for obfuscated message relay and decentralized governance simulations.

Practical Implications and Verification

Because the platform relies entirely on public data feeds and self-hosted environments, operators retain control over external API keys and data sources. Users interested in verifying the software's functionality can review the complete source code repositories available on GitHub or deploy containers locally using Docker or Helm charts. Operators must note that experimental features like InfoNet are currently unverified and intended for testnet environments rather than private communications.

To confirm official updates or inspect the security model, users should consult the official repository documentation and verify container release digests directly through project-maintained verification guidelines.
